title: Curvature Sensitive Cells in the Modular Structures of The Visual Cortex
summary: We propose a model of the functional architecture of curvature-sensitive cells in the primary visual cortex. The model accounts for the modular and hierarchical organization of the cortex, the horizontal connectivity, and the shape of receptive profiles of these cells as Gabor-type filters. We construct a canonical affine subbundle of the cotangent bundle of the manifold of oriented contact elements of the retina as a geometric model for these cells, and show that this subbundle carries an Engel structure related to that of the Cartan prolongation.
